theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtsd_sh_boundaryMassOn_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn U m, boundaryMassOn (X - Y) G ≤ boundaryMassOn X G + boundaryMassOn Y G) ∧ ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), boundaryMassOn X.boundary G = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
